svg.title: Sudan: Areas of Control
svg.desc: Situation map covering 21.0°E to 39.4°E, 7.9°N to 23.0°N. Schematic · the war's east-west partition, with the fighting in Kordofan. Areas of control in 5 classes: Sudanese Armed Forces, Rapid Support Forces, SPLM-N (al-Hilu), SLM-AW (Jebel Marra), Contested (approx.) (contested). An approximate front line is drawn. Marked: Contested town (approx.). Schematic polygons drawn by hand from the sources below, not a geocoded dataset. Open-source reporting (ACLED, Sudans Post territorial-control tracking). As of ~25 September 2026 · illustrative, not an operational assessment. The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.
